reading: Germany has blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.
Russia denies that it tried to attack a Ukrainian cargo plane there.
A robot was used to make an explosive drone safe.
The airport is an important Nato hub used by Ukrainian transport aircraft.
The EU and Nato have promised to increase pressure on Russia.
Nato’s leader has also expressed support for Germany.
European ministers are discussing stronger enforcement of sanctions and further visa restrictions.
Russia is accused of acting more recklessly.
